issue.title: Jump pin landing repairs
issue.description: Every Ctrl+J jump pin lands exactly once, on the right task, after every write of the gesture has landed, on all three surfaces. A pinned close from a `]s` landing still records its review answer. The card capsule looks the way the design specifies.
